notes.title: Update Notes for Dec. 18, 2023
notes.content:
[list][*]Adds falling sakura petal effects in certain scenes.
[*]Fixes CG unlocking: All CGs should now be unlockable and the CG gallery should now scroll correctly.
[*]Adds character animations and reactions that occur in mid-line.
[*]Modifies and improves the behavior of several effects and transitions.
[*]Adds fancy images to the UI buttons at the top of the screen.
[*]Adds per-character Voice Volume and Mute configuration, accessible via the Settings menu.
[*]The second halves of long lines should no longer cause the textbox opacity to change in Fixed UI mode.
[*]Fixes a number of typos and text issues.[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934910/Kunado_Chronicles/

notes.title: Hotfix for 4/11 Patch
notes.content: - Fixed an issue that occurred in the previous version when the new Skip Mode was used in combination with the Stop Skipping at Unread Text setting.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 11
notes.content:
[list][*]Added a clickable Skip button to the Menu Bar at the top of the game window.
[*]Added a Pin UI checkbox to the Menu Bar at the top of the game window. Un-checking this box will cause the Menu Bar to become transparent when not in use. When the Menu Bar is hidden, you can still mouse over the upper area of the game window to cause the bar to reappear as usual.
[*]Various typo & textual fixes.
[*]T.CHINESE: Fixed an issue that caused certain characters to display incorrectly in the game's font.
[*]S.CHINESE: Fixed an issue that caused one entry in the Menu Bar to overflow.[/list]
If you are using any external patches or mods, please update these to the latest version as well to ensure correct functionality.

[hr][/hr]
As a port of the original game to a different engine, this international version of Kunado Chronicles contains some functionality that differs from the behavior of the Japanese version.
Thanks to those users who have contributed feedback to help us identify areas where the port could be improved.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934910/Kunado_Chronicles/
